title: BackendCapability
description: A backend's self-declared capability certificate. Documents how a specific backend realizes the abstract Tribunus machine on real hardware. Every gap or limitation is a declared, audited capability, not a silent fallback.

artifact_identity_level.description: Strongest identity guarantee this backend can provide.

island_memory.description: How this backend interacts with the executor's memory island.

has_runtime_code_path.description: True if this backend compiles or loads code at runtime that the executor cannot pre-verify. If true, the executor wraps it in an evidence adapter that records artifact identity at qualification time.
